Alert me when purchases exceed the limit

Choose a limit for one salary period. We compare actual and expected purchases, including cash withdrawals and outgoing external transfers. Leave blank to stop monitoring the limit; this does not change forecasts or block spending.
A reminder before a recorded commitment is due. Choose the number of days; the default is three.
Alert me when a recurring payment increases
Alerts when a recurring payment increases by at least 20% and SAR 10 against three earlier payments. It does not change a commitment automatically.
Turning this off keeps alerts available in the in-app notification center.
